name: Brother Bill's Helping Hand
hoursNotes: By appointment. Extra sessions: 4th Thursday 5–6:30pm, 4th Friday 9:30–11am, 2nd Saturday 9–11:30am. Produce Days 1st & 3rd Fridays 9–10:30am (no appointment needed).
requirements: Grocery appointment required before receiving food; new clients register online, existing clients call. Each family may shop once per month.
notes: Choice-model grocery store in West Dallas; also runs a community health clinic, ESL/job training, and youth programs.
